recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. issue_request: FHIR-32667 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Library request to add guidance and conformance expectations for using the version parameter of the media type on Library.content.contentType for CQL and ELM library content.
initial_application: The seed Jira comment points to HL7/fhir PR #2635. The relevant core source commit in that trail, 2e2ccec2adf474bbdbb66019700fc8f71ecc3b99, added a Clinical Reasoning/Using Expressions pointer to consolidated CQL usage guidance rather than duplicating detailed Library.content.contentType rules in FHIR core.
additional_context: Related FHIR-30570 comments explain that CQL library guidance was consolidated outside the base specification and linked from core. The current core source keeps that pointer, now to the published Using CQL with FHIR IG. The current CQL IG conformance page includes the direct CQL Version rule: Library CQL/ELM content SHOULD specify the version parameter of text/cql, application/elm+xml, and application/elm+json; specified values SHALL match published CQL major/minor versions; and narratives SHALL include specified versions. Later FHIR-uv-cql issues FHIR-43877 and FHIR-49605 refine and confirm that external guidance.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scoped core source points implementers to the maintained CQL IG, and that IG contains the requested version-parameter guidance and conformance expectations.

related_jiras.note: Its comments document the decision to consolidate CQL library usage guidance outside FHIR core and point to it from Clinical Reasoning.
The same CQL/ELM media-type version guidance was applied in the US QM/CQF measures context, outside FHIR core.
A later FHIR-uv-cql issue corrected profile conflicts caused by versioned media type parameters, confirming the guidance is maintained in the CQL IG.
A later FHIR-uv-cql issue retained SHOULD for specifying the version parameter and documented the rationale.
